title: HS40089: Transportation Economics
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisites: NoneCourse ContentsSignificance of Transport in Economics;
Transport Infrastructure and System; Transport in Economics and Regional
Development; Demand for and Supply of Transport; Transport Cost (Internal and
External); Optimal Pricing of Transport Services; Investment into the Transport
Sector; Cost-Benefit Analysis; Travel Demand and the Value of Travel Time;
Improvement of Transport and Joint Land Use; Returns to Scale; Transport
Planning and Forecasting; Transport Policy: Regulations, Priorities in
Transport Policy; Public versus Private Transport; Transport and Public
Welfare.
